source.title: Dromore Leader, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Nominations for Down County Council"); Banbridge Chronicle, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Banbridge Rural Council: 20 divisions, 14 nominations")
source.publisher: Dromore Leader (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the 20 electoral divisions of Banbridge rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Nominations were received on 17 May: fourteen divisions were filled unopposed, and no nomination was received for Balloolymore, Ballybrick, Ballyward, Leitrim, Skeagh or Tullylish. New member. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
